task: Replace the load option maxMergeSeqLength (default 20) with maxTotalMergeKeys (default 10000). The sequence limit does not stop a merge bomb built from a chain of aliases. The new option caps the total number of keys processed by merge (<<) across one whole load() or loadAll() call. Every key visited during a merge counts, even one that turns out to be already present, and in loadAll the counter is shared across all documents, not reset per document. Past the limit, throw a YAMLException with the message "merge keys exceeded maxTotalMergeKeys (<limit>)". A value of -1 disables the check. Remove maxMergeSeqLength and its check entirely, and also remove the deduplication of repeated sources in <<: [...], so repeated sources are processed and counted again. Update the option list in README.md. Examples: three sources of one key each pass with maxTotalMergeKeys 5 and -1 and throw with 2. Two documents that each merge two keys pass loadAll with 4 and throw with 3. A chain of 150 anchors where each mapping merges the previous one and adds a key loads with -1 and the last mapping has 150 keys. The same chain with 100000 anchors throws a YAMLException under the default limit with YAML11_SCHEMA.
